title: Group-shared MLA latent with layer-specific Mirror reconstruction views
hypothesis: A rank-128 PCA latent basis shared across each three-layer group, with a compact layer-specific rank-4 residual View, recovers per-layer K/V behavior at lower total storage than per-layer MLA bases and FP16 caches.
physical_object: 6-layer Pythia KV state, grouped into fixed layers [0,1,2] and [3,4,5], 8 heads x K/V x 64 dimensions, 64-token prefix
mirror_coordinate: Per-token, per-layer, per-K/V-role rank-4 coefficient m against a residual dictionary shared across each 3-layer group
controls: group-shared rank-128 PCA without residual View
group-shared rank-128 PCA + layer-specific rank-4 residual codes
exact native group-shared residual dictionary/code control
per-layer PCA + private per-head rank-4 residual bases

calibration.group_pca: centered joint 1024D K/V vectors pooled across the 3 layers; retain rank 128
calibration.residual_dictionary: rank-4 PCA per K/V role, pooled over layers within each group; layer-specific token coefficients are m
calibration.private_upper_control: rank-4 PCA residual basis separately per layer and role

evaluation.metric: next-token NLL after one query token using reconstructed cached prefix

development.selection_metric: NLL, K/V reconstruction MSE, actual serialized model-state and per-session cache bytes, 1/4/8-session totals, fit/encode/reconstruct/query wall time

paid_objects: FP16 group or per-layer residual decoder bases
per-session FP16 latent and residual codes
all shape, dtype and schema metadata

success_gate: Both dev seeds: Mirror NLL delta <=0.05 nat/token versus FP16 and >=0.02 nat/token better than group-shared rank128 without residual; per-session cache bytes <=0.25x FP16; total model-state plus 8 sessions <=0.75x eight FP16 caches; strictly smaller actual model-state+cache payload than per-layer MLA; no exact native-control alias.
failure_gate: Any quality/bytes miss, no storage reduction versus per-layer MLA, or exact native group-shared dictionary/code alias.
boundaries: PCA is applied after Pythia produces K/V; the projection weights are not replaced
One query token after a compressed prefix is scored; this is not full-sequence perplexity
CPU reconstruction and operation proxies only; no fused serving kernel claim
Fresh test split remains sealed after any development gate miss or native alias
